title: AI-rays: Exploring Bias in the Gaze of AI Through a Multimodal Interactive Installation

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the keywords and personal items generated by a GPT-4V pipeline for male versus female images to identify stereotypical associations (e.g., assigning beauty products and 'vegetarianism' to women, and 'Tech Expert' or violent items to men).

Comparing the inferred interests and keywords generated by the AI for images of Black, Caucasian, and East Asian individuals to uncover demographic correlations, such as associating specific music preferences (like jazz) with skin color.

Evaluating the AI's stereotypical associations by comparing images of individuals in specific occupational attire (e.g., doctors) against those with non-specific occupations and tracking the generated personality traits (e.g., 'compassionate' or 'detail-oriented').

Prompting the multimodal model to infer economic status from appearance and observing disparities in perceived wealth and assigned items based on subjects' clothing choices (e.g., Arab robes versus casual attire).
